import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def qpow(x, n):
    return pow(x, n, MOD)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    P = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])
    
    if K == 0:
        result = qpow(P, P - 1)
        sys.stdout.write(str(result))
        return
    if K == 1:
        result = qpow(P, P)
        sys.stdout.write(str(result))
        return
    
    vis = [False] * P
    p = 1
    cnt = 0
    while True:
        cnt += 1
        vis[p] = True
        p = (K * p) % P
        if vis[p]:
            break
    result = qpow(P, P // cnt)
    sys.stdout.write(str(result))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
